title: Facet force at L2-L3, L3-L4, L4-L5 - Wiseman CM, Lindsey DP, Fredrick AD, Yerby SA 2005 (secondary, Ghezelbash 2020 review)

quantity.name: facet force
quantity.definition: facet force +/- SD (pressure sensor) under 15 Nm extension + 700 N compression

source.authors: Ghezelbash F, Schmidt H, Shirazi-Adl A, El-Rich M
source.sample: not stated in review (see primary: Wiseman CM, Lindsey DP, Fredrick AD, Yerby SA 2005); human cadaveric lumbar specimens of Wiseman CM, Lindsey DP, Fredrick AD, Yerby SA 2005, as compiled in Ghezelbash et al. 2020 Table 2

protocol.summary: 15 Nm extension with 700 N compression; pressure sensor.
how_to_simulate: Apply 700 N compression plus 15 Nm extension
Report facet force at L2-L3, L3-L4, L4-L5
protocol.notes: Secondary data compiled in a review (Ghezelbash et al.'s review). Sample size, specimen age, rate and cycles are not given in the review; use the primary paper for these. Primary source: Wiseman CM, Lindsey DP, Fredrick AD, Yerby SA 2005.

extraction.from: Table 2 (summary of in vitro facet force measurements)
extraction.check_notes: Re-read against the rendered Table 2 image (page 5, 200 dpi): every value, +/-, min/max, units and level labels match the pdftotext output.

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= 1 SD (mean+/-SD) or min <= model <= max (ranges); widen for facet-force method bias (Wilson 2006)
